behaviour.strength: Common magnesium alloys lose strength as temperature rises; exact retention is grade/temper dependent.
behaviour.creep: Creep becomes increasingly important for sustained load at elevated temperature, particularly in common Mg-Al alloys.
behaviour.fatigue: Temperature alters cyclic deformation and environmental sensitivity.
behaviour.dimensional_stability: CTE and temperature-dependent modulus must be included for precision applications.

rule: The temperature bands are screening categories, not service-temperature limits.
